# `no-tools`

**Page rule** · `info` · on by default

Reports pages that expose no tools at all, which usually means registration failed.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "no-tools": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "no-tools": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule no-tools=off
```
